Kerala High Court Orders FIR Against Former CM Vijayan Over Corruption Allegations

The Kerala High Court has ordered the registration of a First Information Report (FIR) against former Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and his daughter concerning corruption allegations. The court's directive mandates an investigation into the matter.
